verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Sai can save replayable skills (simular-docs-8) and that saved code self-heals when the UI changes (simular-docs-9). Nothing documents version history, reviewing changes to an automation, or rolling one back. Watching live runs (simular-docs-17) is run observation, an adjacent feature, not review or versioning of the automation itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
